decisions.reason: As an upgraded and renamed version of an already accepted screen that stayed on its own product page through 2019, it appears to meet aspiration levels well enough for an experienced machinery maker with service slack to keep refining rather than drop it.
The firm updated the whole flail-shredder line to EU Stage V in 2019, which signals commitment, portfolio fit, and performance at least near aspirations, so management would likely retain it.

This grinder line fits the core mobile-processing business but has thinner public evidence of market traction than the stronger lines, so it is the most at risk of portfolio pruning yet still likely to be kept while results remain uncertain.

The stationary pre-shredder line was still prominently presented in 2019 with language claiming segment leadership and a concrete application reference, indicating results above aspiration and a strong case for continuation.
